description: This file defines a VoiceWakeForwarder utility in Swift that handles voice wake forwarding, including creating transcript messages, managing connection status, and error handling via custom enums and structs.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: An enum conforming to LocalizedError and Equatable to represent errors during voice wake forwarding, specifically RPC failures.

classes.name: ForwardOptions
classes.description: A struct encapsulating options for forwarding voice transcripts, such as session key, processing intensity, delivery flag, destination, and channel.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Constructs a prefixed transcript message including machine name information, handling optional machine name and fallback sources.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a voice transcript with options, returning success or failure based on RPC response.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the connection status of the gateway, returning success if connected, failure otherwise.
